integrity: The matching bijection is proved directly. Real-rootedness is deduced from the Heilmann-Lieb theorem, and finite computations are sanity checks rather than proof. Prior matching-in-leave work is explicitly separated from the claimed polynomial synthesis.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns labelled induced one-point extensions of finite partial Steiner triple systems. Classical embedding arguments already use matchings in leave graphs, so the novelty claim is restricted to the full extension generating polynomial and the resulting real-rootedness/ultra-log-concavity. Automorphism-quotiented extensions and complete types of the functional model completion are not counted.
title: Real-rooted one-point extension spectra of partial Steiner triple systems
